messages:
carmen: Partner ops reported duplicate daily credits tied to timezone cutoff mismatch. They see two daily windows intersecting for ~12 hours for APAC customers.
liam: Yikes. Do they include window_start/window_end in payloads?
carmen: They do, but they send local midnight (Asia/Kolkata) and our ingestion converts to UTC incorrectly. Example payload they shared: ```{
  "account_id": "acct_PARTNERZ",
  "usage_window_start": "2026-03-01T00:00:00+05:30",
  "usage_window_end": "2026-03-01T23:59:59+05:30",
  "units": 120
}``` We treated that as two windows when we normalized to UTC because we applied server-day cutover at 00:00 UTC for daily rollups.
nora: So partner assumes daily rollup aligned to their local day but marketplace contract says UTC day by default. Did we ever confirm day boundary with partner?
felix: Not explicitly. Marketplace metering doc says vendor should send timestamp with explicit offset; ingestion should respect offset and map to UTC day. Our bug is double-counting during DST transition + when partner also sends both local and UTC fields.
liam: Short-term fix: change aggregator to dedupe by event signature (account + window_start_utc + window_end_utc + event_id if present). Also treat payload offsets as authoritative and compute the UTC-aligned day once.
carmen: Partner wants retro credits for 3 affected billing periods. We'll need a reconciled delta per account.
felix: I'll add a lightweight reconciliation tool that: 1) re-parses partner raw events respecting offsets, 2) recomputes daily aggregates using our defined UTC-day window or partner-agreed window, 3) computes diffs vs billed.
nora: We'll need partner agreement on day boundary going forward. Options: (a) force UTC day for all partners, (b) allow partner-local-day if they opt-in and sign SLA. Which do we prefer?
liam: Default to UTC day (marketplace standard). For partners requiring local-day semantics, require explicit opt-in and a contract flag. Also require event_id and idempotency window to avoid duplicates.
carmen: Backfill plan: run reconciliation tool for affected accounts, tag invoices with adjustment entries, apply credits where diff > $1 or >0.5% of invoice. Billing ops to sanity-check.
account-bot: Created ticket PD-12099: "partner timezone windowing causing duplicate daily usage - acct_PARTNERZ" assigned to @felix (P2).
felix: I'll prototype the reconciliation run today and post results in PD-12099. Will include a CSV of affected account IDs and suggested credit amounts.
nora: Also update our partner webhook schema to require either: (1) explicit UTC timestamps, or (2) explicit timezone offset and event_id. Reject ambiguous payloads.
liam: Add monitoring: "daily-usage-dup-count" per partner and alert if >0.1% of events flagged as overlapping.
carmen: Thanks all — please loop legal/billing before issuing credits. I'll draft partner comms after we have reconciliation numbers. :thumbsup:
